EnvironmentOutputPayload.description:
environment_output: one chunk of output from preparing the environment,
including the customer's own hooks. Many fire per message; `chunk` orders
them within a step.

EnvironmentPhasePayload.description:
environment_phase: one transition of environment preparation, so clients
can narrate progress live and locate failures. Phases are an OPEN
vocabulary; `detail` carries phase-specific extras additively.
EnvironmentPhasePayload.title: EnvironmentPhasePayload

EnvironmentReadyPayload.description:
environment_ready: the environment is prepared and the agent is about
to start.

MessageEndedPayload.description:
message_ended: the message was answered, or its answer failed, was
stopped, or was cancelled. `error` is the same object as the session's
`error`, null when the message was answered. `cost` and `tokens` are what
answering it spent. Messages answered together report the spend once, on
the last of them.
MessageEndedPayload.title: MessageEndedPayload

MessageQueuedPayload.description:
message_queued: the message waits because the account already has
`sessions_alive` sessions alive, its limit.
MessageQueuedPayload.title: MessageQueuedPayload

MessageRequeuedPayload.description:
message_requeued: the agent was interrupted before answering, so the
message goes back to the inbox and starts again on a fresh environment.
MessageRequeuedPayload.title: MessageRequeuedPayload

MessageStartedPayload.description: message_started: the agent started on the message.
MessageStartedPayload.title: MessageStartedPayload
